_note: Baseline for the CI audit ratchet. These are upstream, transitive through @bagsfm/bags-sdk and @solana/web3.js, and unfixable from here: npm audit fix --force would downgrade the SDK to 1.0.8 (no trade/partner services) and web3.js to 0.0.3. CI fails if any CRITICAL appears, or if any count rises above these numbers. Lower them whenever upstream ships fixes.
